title: The Sharpness Disparity Principle in Transformers for Accelerating Language Model Pre-Training
abstract: arXiv:2502.19002v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformers consist of diverse building blocks, such as embedding layers, normalization layers, self-attention mechanisms, and point-wise feedforward networks. Thus, understanding the differences and interactions among these blocks is important. In this paper, we uncover a clear Sharpness Disparity across these blocks, which emerges early in training and intriguingly persists throughout the training process. Motivated by this finding, we propose Blockwise Learning Rate (LR), a strategy that tailors the LR to each block's sharpness, accelerating large language model (LLM) pre-training. By integrating Blockwise LR into AdamW, we consistently achieve lower terminal loss and nearly $2\times$ speedup compared to vanilla AdamW. We demonstrate this acceleration across GPT-2 and LLaMA, with model sizes ranging from 0.12B to 2B and datasets of OpenWebText, MiniPile, and C4. translated_title: Transformer中的锐度差异原理用于加速语言模型预训练
translated_abstract: Transformer由多种构建模块组成，例如嵌入层、归一化层、自注意力机制和逐点前馈网络，因此理解这些模块之间的差异与相互作用十分重要。本文揭示了这些模块之间清晰存在的“锐度差异”，这一差异在训练早期便会显现，并有趣地在整个训练过程中持续存在。受此发现启发，我们提出了分块学习率策略，即根据每个模块的锐度为其定制学习率，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的预训练。将分块学习率集成到AdamW中后，与原始AdamW相比，我们持续获得了更低的最终损失以及接近2倍的加速。我们在GPT-2和LLaMA上、模型规模从0.12B到2B、数据集涵盖OpenWebText、MiniPile和C4的情况下验证了这一加速效果。最后，我们将分块学习率集成到了Adam-mini中（Zhang et al., 202…）
tldr: 本文发现Transformer各模块间存在训练早期出现且贯穿全程的“锐度差异”，据此提出按各模块锐度定制学习率的Blockwise LR策略，集成到AdamW后在多种模型和数据集上实现近2倍的预训练加速并取得更低最终损失。
en_tdlr: This paper uncovers a Sharpness Disparity across Transformer blocks that emerges early in training and persists throughout, and proposes a Blockwise Learning Rate strategy tailored to each block's sharpness, which when integrated into AdamW achieves nearly 2x speedup in LLM pre-training with lower terminal loss.
